title: Isomorphisms in the filtered colimit category have covering stage representatives
statement: Let J be filtered, F a diagram of small categories, P stage precoverages with singleton isomorphisms, and V a cocone whose object and arrow cocones are colimits. For every isomorphism f:S→T in V.pt there are a stage j, an object X, a stage covering presieve R on X, and an equality h:(V.ι.app j).toFunctor.obj X=T such that transporting R.map(V.ι.app j).toFunctor along h gives the singleton presieve of f.

source.place: Tag 09YL, filtered colimit representation of an isomorphism

proof.text: Represent f and its inverse by arrows at stages using joint surjectivity of the arrow colimit. Filteredness gives a common stage and representatives with matching endpoints. Apply the filtered-colimit equality criterion to both inverse equations and refine once more so both equations hold at the same stage. The resulting stage arrow is an isomorphism, whose singleton is covering by the stage HasIsos axiom; functoriality and the endpoint equality identify its image presieve with the singleton of f.

theorem filtered_colimit_iso_presieve_representation
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    [∀ j, (P j).HasIsos]
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    {S T : V.pt} (f : S ⟶ T) [IsIso f] :
    ∃ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X)
      (h : (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.obj X = T),
      R ∈ P j X ∧ h ▸ R.map (V.ι.app j).toFunctor = Presieve.singleton f
